messages.author: bc49002c7e271411
messages.subject: Shiny server and systemd
parts:
Hi all.

I am using Shiny-server v0.3.0 successfully on a Fedora 16 box.  I am starting the service manually using sudo shiny-server and that works just fine!

However, I would like to start the service automatically and I believe that Fedora 16 uses the systemd approach.  Has anyone managed to use that to start shiny-server?
Alternatively, if anyone has another approach that would work on Fedora 16, I would love to hear it!

Thanks.
-Anand

messages.author: bc49002c7e271411
messages.subject: Re: Shiny server and systemd
parts:
Ok, I took a stab at making a systemd compatible script.
I put the following (in between the dashed lines below) into a file (shiny.service) and copied that file to /lib/systemd/system.  This is on Fedora 16.  Then I ran the following commands as sudo.

1) sudo systemctl daemon-reload
2) sudo systemctl start shiny.service

Then I went to an app and sure enough, it works.

I think you can add the following line to end of the [Service] unit to tell systemd to automatically restart this service when it dies.
Restart=restart-always

---------shiny.service------------------------
[Unit]
Description=shiny-server deploys R shiny applications
After=syslog.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/shiny-server
Type=forking

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
---------------------------------------
